CREATE TABLE People (
    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Name STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (PersonId);

-- Leaf Class: Organization (Subclass of Party)
CREATE TABLE Organizations (
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Name STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (OrganizationId);

-- Leaf Class: PersonalAccount (Subclass of Account)
-- Equivalent Class 'HighRiskAccount' is implemented via a STORED Generated Column.
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccounts (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    AccountBalance NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    IsHighRisk BOOL AS (AccountBalance > 100000.00) STORED,
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId);

-- Leaf Class: CorporateAccount (Subclass of Account)
-- Equivalent Class 'HighRiskAccount' is implemented via a STORED Generated Column.
CREATE TABLE CorporateAccounts (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    AccountBalance NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    IsHighRisk BOOL AS (AccountBalance > 100000.00) STORED,
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId);

-- Object Property: hasOwner (PersonalAccount -> Person)
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccountOwners (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_PersAccOwn_Acc FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES PersonalAccounts (AccountId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PersAccOwn_Pers FOREIGN KEY (PersonId) REFERENCES People (PersonId),
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId, PersonId);

-- Object Property: hasOwner (CorporateAccount -> Organization)
CREATE TABLE CorporateAccountOwners (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CorpAccOwn_Acc FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES CorporateAccounts (AccountId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CorpAccOwn_Org FOREIGN KEY (OrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId),

    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Sign_Acc FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES PersonalAccounts (AccountId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Sign_Pers FOREIGN KEY (PersonId) REFERENCES People (PersonId),
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId, PersonId);

-- Object Property: isPartnerOf (Symmetric: Organization -> Organization)
CREATE TABLE OrganizationPartners (
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    PartnerOrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Part_Org FOREIGN KEY (OrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Part_Partner FOREIGN KEY (PartnerOrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId),

-- Category Table
CREATE TABLE Categories (
    CategoryId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,

) PRIMARY KEY (CategoryId);

-- Category Hierarchy (Interleaved Table representing Transitive subCategoryOf)
-- Satisfies Rule 3: PK starts with Parent PK (CategoryId)
CREATE TABLE CategoryHierarchy (
    CategoryId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    SubCategoryId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CategoryHierarchy_Sub FOREIGN KEY (SubCategoryId) REFERENCES Categories (CategoryId)
) PRIMARY KEY (CategoryId, SubCategoryId),
INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Categories ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Product Tables (Table-Per-Class: Flattened Superclass Properties)
CREATE TABLE Books (
    ProductId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    ProductPrice NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    CategoryId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Books_Category FOREIGN KEY (CategoryId) REFERENCES Categories (CategoryId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId);

CREATE TABLE Electronics (
    ProductId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    ProductPrice NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    CategoryId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Electronics_Category FOREIGN KEY (CategoryId) REFERENCES Categories (CategoryId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId);

CREATE TABLE Clothing (
    ProductId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    ProductPrice NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    CategoryId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Clothing_Category FOREIGN KEY (CategoryId) REFERENCES Categories (CategoryId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId);

-- User Tables (Table-Per-Class: Flattened Superclass Properties)
-- Disjointness enforced via physical separation into distinct tables
CREATE TABLE Customers (
    CustomerId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    UserName STRING(MAX) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (CustomerId);

CREATE TABLE Merchants (
    MerchantId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    UserName STRING(MAX) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (MerchantId);

-- Orders Table
CREATE TABLE Orders (
    OrderId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    CustomerId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    OrderDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Orders_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerId) REFERENCES Customers (CustomerId)
) PRIMARY KEY (OrderId);

-- Order Items (Interleaved Table representing orderContains)
-- Satisfies Rule 3: PK starts with Parent PK (OrderId)
CREATE TABLE OrderItems (
    OrderId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    ItemId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    BookId STRING(MAX),
    ElectronicsId STRING(MAX),
    ClothingId STRING(MAX),
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItems_Book FOREIGN KEY (BookId) REFERENCES Books (ProductId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItems_Electronics FOREIGN KEY (ElectronicsId) REFERENCES Electronics (ProductId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItems_Clothing FOREIGN KEY (ClothingId) REFERENCES Clothing (ProductId),
    CONSTRAINT CHK_OrderItemTarget CHECK (
        (BookId IS NOT NULL AND ElectronicsId IS NULL AND ClothingId IS NULL) OR
        (BookId IS NULL AND ElectronicsId IS NOT NULL AND ClothingId IS NULL) OR
        (BookId IS NULL AND ElectronicsId IS NULL AND ClothingId IS NOT NULL)
    )
) PRIMARY KEY (OrderId, ItemId),
INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Orders ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Reviews Table
-- Equivalent Class HighRatingReview is modeled via a STORED Generated Column (IsHighRating)
CREATE TABLE Reviews (
    ReviewId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    CustomerId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
    BookId STRING(MAX),
    ElectronicsId STRING(MAX),
    ClothingId STRING(MAX),
    RatingValue INT64 NOT NULL,

    IsHighRating BOOL AS (RatingValue >= 4) STORED,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Reviews_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerId) REFERENCES Customers (CustomerId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Reviews_Book FOREIGN KEY (BookId) REFERENCES Books (ProductId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Reviews_Electronics FOREIGN KEY (ElectronicsId) REFERENCES Electronics (ProductId),

    CONSTRAINT CHK_ReviewTarget CHECK (

        (BookId IS NULL AND ElectronicsId IS NOT NULL AND ClothingId IS NULL) OR
        (BookId IS NULL AND ElectronicsId IS NULL AND ClothingId IS NOT NULL)

    TargetProductId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL

-- =============================================================================
-- 1. PHYSICAL RELATIONAL SCHEMA (TABLE-PER-CLASS)
-- =============================================================================

-- Leaf Class: Corporation (Inherits from LegalEntity, AutonomousAgent)
CREATE TABLE Corporations (
  CorporationId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  leiCode STRING(20) NOT NULL,          -- Cardinality 1 Restriction
  legalName STRING(255),
) PRIMARY KEY (CorporationId);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX Idx_Corporations_LeiCode ON Corporations (leiCode);

-- Leaf Class: Partnership (Inherits from LegalEntity, AutonomousAgent)
CREATE TABLE Partnerships (
  PartnershipId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  leiCode STRING(20) NOT NULL,          -- Cardinality 1 Restriction
  legalName STRING(255),
) PRIMARY KEY (PartnershipId);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX Idx_Partnerships_LeiCode ON Partnerships (leiCode);

-- Leaf Class: ContractualParty (Inherits from AutonomousAgent)
CREATE TABLE ContractualParties (
  PartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  partyName STRING(255),
) PRIMARY KEY (PartyId);

-- Leaf Class: Loan (Inherits from FinancialInstrument)
CREATE TABLE Loans (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  loanAmount NUMERIC NOT NULL,
  interestRate NUMERIC,
  lenderPartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,    -- Loan hasLender ContractualParty Restriction
  borrowerPartyId STRING(36),
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: SignificantCorporateLoan (Amount > 10,000,000.00)
  isSignificantCorporateLoan BOOL AS (loanAmount > 10000000.00) STORED,
  CONSTRAINT FK_Loan_Lender FOREIGN KEY (lenderPartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Loan_Borrower FOREIGN KEY (borrowerPartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId),
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId);

-- Interleaved Table: Loan Guarantors (Corporations) - Physical Co-location
CREATE TABLE LoanGuarantorCorporations (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CorporationId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_Guarantor_Corp FOREIGN KEY (CorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId),
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId, CorporationId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Loans ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Interleaved Table: Loan Guarantors (Partnerships) - Physical Co-location
CREATE TABLE LoanGuarantorPartnerships (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  PartnershipId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_Guarantor_Part FOREIGN KEY (PartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId),
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId, PartnershipId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Loans ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Leaf Class: Share (Inherits from Security, FinancialInstrument)
CREATE TABLE Shares (
  ShareId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  isinCode STRING(12),
  sharesOutstanding INT64,
  -- Polymorphic Foreign Keys for issuedBy (LegalEntity)
  issuerCorporationId STRING(36),
  issuerPartnershipId STRING(36),
  -- Polymorphic Foreign Keys for ownedBy (LegalEntity)
  ownerCorporationId STRING(36),
  ownerPartnershipId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Share_IssuerCorp FOREIGN KEY (issuerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Share_IssuerPart FOREIGN KEY (issuerPartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Share_OwnerCorp FOREIGN KEY (ownerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Share_OwnerPart FOREIGN KEY (ownerPartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId),
) PRIMARY KEY (ShareId);

-- Leaf Class: DebtInstrument (Inherits from Security, FinancialInstrument)
CREATE TABLE DebtInstruments (
  DebtInstrumentId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  isinCode STRING(12),
  -- Polymorphic Foreign Keys for issuedBy (LegalEntity)
  issuerCorporationId STRING(36),
  issuerPartnershipId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Debt_IssuerCorp FOREIGN KEY (issuerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Debt_IssuerPart FOREIGN KEY (issuerPartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId),
) PRIMARY KEY (DebtInstrumentId);

-- Symmetric Property Table: sharesGuarantorRiskWith (LegalEntity <-> LegalEntity)
CREATE TABLE GuarantorAlliances (
  EntityAId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  EntityBId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (EntityAId, EntityBId);

-- Transitive Property Table: controlledBy (LegalEntity <-> LegalEntity)
CREATE TABLE CorporateControl (
  ControlledEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ControllingEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ControlledEntityId, ControllingEntityId);

-- =============================================================================
-- 2. LOGICAL VIEWS FOR EQUIVALENT CLASSES
-- =============================================================================

CREATE VIEW SignificantCorporateLoans SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT 
  LoanId, 
  loanAmount, 
  interestRate, 
  lenderPartyId, 
  borrowerPartyId 
FROM Loans 
WHERE isSignificantCorporateLoan = TRUE;

-- =============================================================================
-- 3. GOOGLE CLOUD SPANNER PROPERTY GRAPH SCHEMA
-- =============================================================================

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH FinancialInstrumentGraph
  NODE TABLES (
    Corporations
      LABEL Corporation PROPERTIES (CorporationId, leiCode, legalName)
      LABEL LegalEntity PROPERTIES (CorporationId AS EntityId, leiCode, legalName)
      LABEL AutonomousAgent PROPERTIES (CorporationId AS AgentId, legalName AS AgentName),
    
    Partnerships
      LABEL Partnership PROPERTIES (PartnershipId, leiCode, legalName)
      LABEL LegalEntity PROPERTIES (PartnershipId AS EntityId, leiCode, legalName)
      LABEL AutonomousAgent PROPERTIES (PartnershipId AS AgentId, legalName AS AgentName),
    
    ContractualParties
      LABEL ContractualParty PROPERTIES (PartyId, partyName)
      LABEL AutonomousAgent PROPERTIES (PartyId AS AgentId, partyName AS AgentName),
    
    Shares
      LABEL Share PROPERTIES (ShareId, isinCode, sharesOutstanding)
      LABEL Security PROPERTIES (ShareId AS SecurityId, isinCode)
      LABEL FinancialInstrument PROPERTIES (ShareId AS InstrumentId),
    
    DebtInstruments
      LABEL DebtInstrument PROPERTIES (DebtInstrumentId, isinCode)
      LABEL Security PROPERTIES (DebtInstrumentId AS SecurityId, isinCode)
      LABEL FinancialInstrument PROPERTIES (DebtInstrumentId AS InstrumentId),
    
    Loans
      LABEL Loan PROPERTIES (LoanId, loanAmount, interestRate)
      LABEL FinancialInstrument PROPERTIES (LoanId AS InstrumentId),
      
    SignificantCorporateLoans
      LABEL SignificantCorporateLoan PROPERTIES (LoanId, loanAmount, interestRate)
      LABEL Loan PROPERTIES (LoanId, loanAmount, interestRate)
      LABEL FinancialInstrument PROPERTIES (LoanId AS InstrumentId)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    -- Object Property: hasLender
    Loans
      SOURCE KEY (LoanId) REFERENCES Loans (LoanId)
      DESTINATION KEY (lenderPartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId)
      LABEL HAS_LENDER PROPERTIES (LoanId, lenderPartyId AS LenderId),
      
    -- Object Property: hasBorrower
    Loans
      SOURCE KEY (LoanId) REFERENCES Loans (LoanId)
      DESTINATION KEY (borrowerPartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId)
      LABEL HAS_BORROWER PROPERTIES (LoanId, borrowerPartyId AS BorrowerId),

    -- Object Property: issuedBy (Polymorphic Mappings)
    Shares
      SOURCE KEY (ShareId) REFERENCES Shares (ShareId)
      DESTINATION KEY (issuerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId)
      LABEL ISSUED_BY PROPERTIES (ShareId AS InstrumentId, issuerCorporationId AS IssuerId),
    Shares
      SOURCE KEY (ShareId) REFERENCES Shares (ShareId)
      DESTINATION KEY (issuerPartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId)
      LABEL ISSUED_BY PROPERTIES (ShareId AS InstrumentId, issuerPartnershipId AS IssuerId),
    DebtInstruments
      SOURCE KEY (DebtInstrumentId) REFERENCES DebtInstruments (DebtInstrumentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (issuerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId)
      LABEL ISSUED_BY PROPERTIES (DebtInstrumentId AS InstrumentId, issuerCorporationId AS IssuerId),
    DebtInstruments
      SOURCE KEY (DebtInstrumentId) REFERENCES DebtInstruments (DebtInstrumentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (issuerPartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId)
      LABEL ISSUED_BY PROPERTIES (DebtInstrumentId AS InstrumentId, issuerPartnershipId AS IssuerId),

    -- Inverse Property: isIssuerOf (Polymorphic Mappings)
    Shares
      SOURCE KEY (issuerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ShareId) REFERENCES Shares (ShareId)
      LABEL IS_ISSUER_OF PROPERTIES (issuerCorporationId AS IssuerId, ShareId AS InstrumentId),
    Shares
      SOURCE KEY (issuerPartnershipId) REFERENCES Partnerships (PartnershipId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ShareId) REFERENCES Shares (ShareId)
      LABEL IS_ISSUER_OF PROPERTIES (issuerPartnershipId AS IssuerId, ShareId AS InstrumentId),
    DebtInstruments
      SOURCE KEY (issuerCorporationId) REFERENCES Corporations (CorporationId)
      DESTINATION KEY (DebtInstrumentId) REFERENCES DebtInstruments (DebtInstrumentId)
      LABEL IS_ISSUER_OF PROPERTIES (issuerCorporationId AS IssuerId, DebtInstrumentId AS InstrumentId),

-- =========================================================================
-- 1. PHYSICAL RELATIONAL SCHEMA (TABLE-PER-CLASS)
-- =========================================================================

-- Concrete implementation of ex:Person (subclass of ex:Party)
CREATE TABLE People (
    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Name STRING(256) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (PersonId);

-- Concrete implementation of ex:Organization (subclass of ex:Party)
CREATE TABLE Organizations (
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Name STRING(256) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (OrganizationId);

-- Concrete implementation of ex:PersonalAccount (subclass of ex:Account)
-- Enforces ex:hasOwner allValuesFrom ex:Person via physical Foreign Key
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccounts (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Balance NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    OwnerPersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    -- Equivalent Class: ex:HighRiskAccount
    IsHighRisk BOOL AS (Balance > 100000.00) STORED,
    CONSTRAINT FK_PersonalAccount_Owner FOREIGN KEY (OwnerPersonId) REFERENCES People (PersonId)
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId);

-- Concrete implementation of ex:CorporateAccount (subclass of ex:Account)
-- Enforces ex:hasOwner allValuesFrom ex:Organization and cardinality 1
CREATE TABLE CorporateAccounts (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Balance NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    OwnerOrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    -- Equivalent Class: ex:HighRiskAccount
    IsHighRisk BOOL AS (Balance > 100000.00) STORED,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CorporateAccount_Owner FOREIGN KEY (OwnerOrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId)
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId);

-- Join Table for ex:hasSignatory (domain: PersonalAccount, range: Person)
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccountSignatories (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    SignatoryPersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Signatory_Account FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES PersonalAccounts (AccountId),

-- =============================================================================

-- Base table for User taxonomy
CREATE TABLE Users (
  UserId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UserName STRING(MAX)
) PRIMARY KEY (UserId);

-- Subclass: Customer (Interleaved in parent Users to guarantee PK alignment)
-- Disjointness with Merchant is enforced via physical separation of child tables.
CREATE TABLE Customers (
  UserId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (UserId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Users ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Subclass: Merchant (Interleaved in parent Users)
CREATE TABLE Merchants (
  UserId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (UserId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Users ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Category Hierarchy Table
CREATE TABLE Categories (
  CategoryId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CategoryName STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  ParentCategoryId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Category_Parent FOREIGN KEY (ParentCategoryId) REFERENCES Categories (CategoryId)
) PRIMARY KEY (CategoryId);

-- Base table for Product taxonomy
CREATE TABLE Products (
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ProductPrice NUMERIC,
  ProductType STRING(50) NOT NULL, -- Discriminator: 'BOOK', 'ELECTRONICS', 'CLOTHING'
  CategoryId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Product_Category FOREIGN KEY (CategoryId) REFERENCES Categories (CategoryId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId);

-- Subclass: Book (Interleaved in parent Products)
CREATE TABLE Books (
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Products ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Subclass: Electronics (Interleaved in parent Products)
CREATE TABLE Electronics (
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Products ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Subclass: Clothing (Interleaved in parent Products)
CREATE TABLE Clothing (
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Products ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Orders Table (Domain: Customer, Range: Order)
CREATE TABLE Orders (
  OrderId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  OrderDate TIMESTAMP,
  CustomerId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_Order_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerId) REFERENCES Customers (UserId)
) PRIMARY KEY (OrderId);

-- Order Contains Products (Many-to-Many Join Table, Interleaved in Orders)
-- Satisfies Rule 3: Primary Key starts with Parent Table's Primary Key (OrderId)
CREATE TABLE OrderProducts (
  OrderId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_OrderProducts_Product FOREIGN KEY (ProductId) REFERENCES Products (ProductId)
) PRIMARY KEY (OrderId, ProductId),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Orders ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Reviews Table (Domain: Review, Range: Customer & Product)
-- Includes a STORED Generated Column representing the Equivalent Class rule (Rule 7)
CREATE TABLE Reviews (
  ReviewId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  RatingValue INT64,
  ReviewText STRING(MAX),
  CustomerId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighRatingReview (RatingValue >= 4)
  IsHighRating BOOL AS (RatingValue >= 4) STORED,
  CONSTRAINT FK_Review_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerId) REFERENCES Customers (UserId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Review_Product FOREIGN KEY (ProductId) REFERENCES Products (ProductId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ReviewId);

-- Symmetric Relationship: Frequently Bought Together (Product <-> Product)
CREATE TABLE RelatedProducts (
  ProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  RelatedProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_Related_Product FOREIGN KEY (ProductId) REFERENCES Products (ProductId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Related_Product_Target FOREIGN KEY (RelatedProductId) REFERENCES Products (ProductId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ProductId, RelatedProductId);

CREATE VIEW HighRatingReviews SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS

-- =============================================================================
-- GOOGLE CLOUD SPANNER PHYSICAL RELATIONAL SCHEMA (DDL)
-- Translation Pattern: Table-Per-Class (Concrete Leaf Flattening)
-- =============================================================================

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Location Taxonomy Tables
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Concrete Leaf Table for ex:Warehouse
CREATE TABLE Warehouses (
  WarehouseId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  -- Cardinality restriction (owl:cardinality 1) mapped to NOT NULL
  LocationCode STRING(100) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (WarehouseId);

-- Concrete Leaf Table for ex:ManufacturingPlant
CREATE TABLE ManufacturingPlants (
  ManufacturingPlantId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100),
) PRIMARY KEY (ManufacturingPlantId);

-- Concrete Leaf Table for ex:SupplierFacility
CREATE TABLE SupplierFacilities (
  SupplierFacilityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100),
) PRIMARY KEY (SupplierFacilityId);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Item Taxonomy Tables
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Concrete Leaf Table for ex:RawMaterial
CREATE TABLE RawMaterials (
  RawMaterialId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: ex:HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  -- Implemented via Spanner Stored Generated Column (Rule 7)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  -- Localized Range Restriction: ex:suppliedBy some ex:SupplierFacility
  SupplierFacilityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  -- Localized Range Restriction: ex:storedIn some ex:Warehouse (Many-to-One)
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_RawMaterial_Supplier FOREIGN KEY (SupplierFacilityId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_RawMaterial_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (RawMaterialId);

-- Concrete Leaf Table for ex:SubAssembly
CREATE TABLE SubAssemblies (
  SubAssemblyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: ex:HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  -- Localized Range Restriction: ex:storedIn some ex:Warehouse (Many-to-One)
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_SubAssembly_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (SubAssemblyId);

-- Concrete Leaf Table for ex:FinishedProduct
CREATE TABLE FinishedProducts (
  FinishedProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: ex:HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  -- Localized Range Restriction: ex:manufacturedAt some ex:ManufacturingPlant
  ManufacturingPlantId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  -- Localized Range Restriction: ex:storedIn some ex:Warehouse (Many-to-One)
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_FinishedProduct_Plant FOREIGN KEY (ManufacturingPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_FinishedProduct_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (FinishedProductId);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Logistics & Carrier Tables
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Concrete Table for ex:Carrier
CREATE TABLE Carriers (
  CarrierId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CarrierName STRING(255),
) PRIMARY KEY (CarrierId);

-- Concrete Table for ex:Shipment
CREATE TABLE Shipments (
  ShipmentId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ShipmentTrackingNumber STRING(100),
  ShipmentDate TIMESTAMP,
  -- Object Property: ex:shippedVia (Shipment -> Carrier)
  CarrierId STRING(36),
  -- Polymorphic Object Property: ex:origin (Shipment -> Location)
  OriginWarehouseId STRING(36),
  OriginPlantId STRING(36),
  OriginSupplierId STRING(36),
  -- Polymorphic Object Property: ex:destination (Shipment -> Location)
  DestinationWarehouseId STRING(36),
  DestinationPlantId STRING(36),
  DestinationSupplierId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Carrier FOREIGN KEY (CarrierId) REFERENCES Carriers (CarrierId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_OriginWH FOREIGN KEY (OriginWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_OriginPlant FOREIGN KEY (OriginPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_OriginSupplier FOREIGN KEY (OriginSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_DestWH FOREIGN KEY (DestinationWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_DestPlant FOREIGN KEY (DestinationPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_DestSupplier FOREIGN KEY (DestinationSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ShipmentId);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Relationship Join Tables (Polymorphic & Transitive Properties)
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Join Table for ex:partOf / ex:hasPart (Transitive Property)
-- Maps polymorphic Item-to-Item relationships
CREATE TABLE ItemParts (
  ParentId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ChildId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ParentType STRING(50) NOT NULL, -- 'RawMaterial', 'SubAssembly', 'FinishedProduct'
  ChildType STRING(50) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ParentId, ChildId);

-- Join Table for ex:connectedTo (Symmetric Property)
-- Maps polymorphic Location-to-Location route connections
CREATE TABLE LocationConnections (
  LocationAId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationBId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationAType STRING(50) NOT NULL, -- 'Warehouse', 'ManufacturingPlant', 'SupplierFacility'
  LocationBType STRING(50) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (LocationAId, LocationBId);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. SQL Views (Strict Name Resolution - Rule 6)
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- View representing the Equivalent Class: ex:HighValueItem
CREATE VIEW HighValueItems SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT r.RawMaterialId AS ItemId, r.UnitCost, r.QuantityInStock, r.IsHighValue
FROM RawMaterials r WHERE r.IsHighValue = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT s.SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, s.UnitCost, s.QuantityInStock, s.IsHighValue
FROM SubAssemblies s WHERE s.IsHighValue = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT f.FinishedProductId AS ItemId, f.UnitCost, f.QuantityInStock, f.IsHighValue
FROM FinishedProducts f WHERE f.IsHighValue = TRUE;


-- =============================================================================
-- GOOGLE CLOUD SPANNER PROPERTY GRAPH SCHEMA (DDL)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH SupplyChainGraph
  NODE TABLES (
    -- Warehouses Node Mapping (Multi-Label Hierarchy - Rule 1 & Rule 2)
    Warehouses
      LABEL Warehouse PROPERTIES (WarehouseId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (WarehouseId AS LocationId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Asset PROPERTIES (WarehouseId AS AssetId),

    -- Manufacturing Plants Node Mapping
    ManufacturingPlants
      LABEL ManufacturingPlant PROPERTIES (ManufacturingPlantId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (ManufacturingPlantId AS LocationId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Asset PROPERTIES (ManufacturingPlantId AS AssetId),

    -- Supplier Facilities Node Mapping
    SupplierFacilities
      LABEL SupplierFacility PROPERTIES (SupplierFacilityId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (SupplierFacilityId AS LocationId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Asset PROPERTIES (SupplierFacilityId AS AssetId),

    -- Raw Materials Node Mapping
    RawMaterials
      LABEL RawMaterial PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId AS ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL Asset PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId AS AssetId),

    -- Sub-Assemblies Node Mapping
    SubAssemblies
      LABEL SubAssembly PROPERTIES (SubAssemblyId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL Asset PROPERTIES (SubAssemblyId AS AssetId),

    -- Finished Products Node Mapping
    FinishedProducts
      LABEL FinishedProduct PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId AS ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL Asset PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId AS AssetId),

    -- Carriers Node Mapping
    Carriers
      LABEL Carrier PROPERTIES (CarrierId, CarrierName),

    -- Shipments Node Mapping
    Shipments
      LABEL Shipment PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, ShipmentTrackingNumber, ShipmentDate),

    -- Equivalent Class View Node Mapping
    HighValueItems
      LABEL HighValueItem PROPERTIES (ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Transitive Property: ex:partOf (Rule 5: Aliasing Edge Tables)
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ItemParts AS RawMaterialPartOfSubAssembly
      SOURCE KEY (ChildId) REFERENCES RawMaterials (RawMaterialId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES SubAssemblies (SubAssemblyId)
      LABEL PART_OF PROPERTIES (ParentId, ChildId),

    ItemParts AS SubAssemblyPartOfSubAssembly
      SOURCE KEY (ChildId) REFERENCES SubAssemblies (SubAssemblyId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES SubAssemblies (SubAssemblyId)
      LABEL PART_OF PROPERTIES (ParentId, ChildId),

    ItemParts AS SubAssemblyPartOfFinishedProduct
      SOURCE KEY (ChildId) REFERENCES SubAssemblies (SubAssemblyId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FinishedProducts (FinishedProductId)
      LABEL PART_OF PROPERTIES (ParentId, ChildId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Object Property: ex:suppliedBy
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    RawMaterials AS RawMaterialSuppliedBy
      SOURCE KEY (RawMaterialId) REFERENCES RawMaterials (RawMaterialId)
      DESTINATION KEY (SupplierFacilityId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
      LABEL SUPPLIED_BY PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId, SupplierFacilityId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Object Property: ex:manufacturedAt
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    FinishedProducts AS ProductManufacturedAt
      SOURCE KEY (FinishedProductId) REFERENCES FinishedProducts (FinishedProductId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ManufacturingPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId)
      LABEL MANUFACTURED_AT PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId, ManufacturingPlantId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Object Property: ex:storedIn (Rule 2: Shared Label Uniformity)
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    RawMaterials AS RawMaterialStoredIn
      SOURCE KEY (RawMaterialId) REFERENCES RawMaterials (RawMaterialId)
      DESTINATION KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
      LABEL STORED_IN PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId AS ItemId, WarehouseId),

    SubAssemblies AS SubAssemblyStoredIn
      SOURCE KEY (SubAssemblyId) REFERENCES SubAssemblies (SubAssemblyId)
      DESTINATION KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
      LABEL STORED_IN PROPERTIES (SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, WarehouseId),

    FinishedProducts AS FinishedProductStoredIn
      SOURCE KEY (FinishedProductId) REFERENCES FinishedProducts (FinishedProductId)
      DESTINATION KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
      LABEL STORED_IN PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId AS ItemId, WarehouseId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Object Property: ex:shippedVia
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Shipments AS ShipmentShippedVia
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (CarrierId) REFERENCES Carriers (CarrierId)
      LABEL SHIPPED_VIA PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, CarrierId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Object Property: ex:origin (Polymorphic Targets)
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Shipments AS ShipmentOriginWarehouse
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (OriginWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
      LABEL ORIGIN PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, OriginWarehouseId AS LocationId),

    Shipments AS ShipmentOriginPlant
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (OriginPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId)
      LABEL ORIGIN PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, OriginPlantId AS LocationId),

    Shipments AS ShipmentOriginSupplier
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (OriginSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
      LABEL ORIGIN PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, OriginSupplierId AS LocationId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Object Property: ex:destination (Polymorphic Targets)
    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Shipments AS ShipmentDestinationWarehouse
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (DestinationWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
      LABEL DESTINATION PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, DestinationWarehouseId AS LocationId),

    Shipments AS ShipmentDestinationPlant
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (DestinationPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId)
      LABEL DESTINATION PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, DestinationPlantId AS LocationId),

    Shipments AS ShipmentDestinationSupplier
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (DestinationSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
      LABEL DESTINATION PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, DestinationSupplierId AS LocationId),

    -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Symmetric Property: ex:connectedTo (Rule 2 & Rule 5)

  leiCode STRING(100) NOT NULL,
  legalName STRING(MAX),
) PRIMARY KEY (CorporationId);

-- Concrete subclass of LegalEntity / AutonomousAgent
CREATE TABLE Partnerships (
  PartnershipId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  leiCode STRING(100) NOT NULL,
  legalName STRING(MAX),
) PRIMARY KEY (PartnershipId);

-- Concrete subclass of AutonomousAgent
CREATE TABLE ContractualParties (
  PartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (PartyId);

-- Concrete subclass of Security / FinancialInstrument
CREATE TABLE Shares (
  ShareId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  isinCode STRING(100),
  sharesOutstanding INT64,
) PRIMARY KEY (ShareId);

-- Concrete subclass of Security / FinancialInstrument
CREATE TABLE DebtInstruments (
  DebtInstrumentId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  isinCode STRING(100),
) PRIMARY KEY (DebtInstrumentId);

-- Concrete subclass of FinancialInstrument
-- Implements Equivalent Class 'SignificantCorporateLoan' via Spanner Generated Column (Rule 7)
CREATE TABLE Loans (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  loanAmount NUMERIC,
  interestRate NUMERIC,
  IsSignificantCorporateLoan BOOL AS (loanAmount > 10000000.00) STORED,
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId);

-- =========================================================================
-- 2. PHYSICAL RELATIONSHIP (EDGE) TABLES
-- =========================================================================

CREATE TABLE LoanLenders (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  PartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_LoanLenders_Loan FOREIGN KEY (LoanId) REFERENCES Loans (LoanId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_LoanLenders_Party FOREIGN KEY (PartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId),
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId, PartyId);

CREATE TABLE LoanBorrowers (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  PartyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_LoanBorrowers_Loan FOREIGN KEY (LoanId) REFERENCES Loans (LoanId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_LoanBorrowers_Party FOREIGN KEY (PartyId) REFERENCES ContractualParties (PartyId),
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId, PartyId);

-- Polymorphic Edge Table: Security -> LegalEntity
CREATE TABLE SecurityIssuers (
  SecurityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LegalEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (SecurityId, LegalEntityId);

-- Polymorphic Edge Table: Share -> LegalEntity
CREATE TABLE ShareOwners (
  ShareId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LegalEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ShareId, LegalEntityId);

-- Polymorphic Edge Table: Loan -> LegalEntity
CREATE TABLE LoanGuarantors (
  LoanId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LegalEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (LoanId, LegalEntityId);

-- Symmetric Edge Table: LegalEntity <-> LegalEntity
CREATE TABLE GuarantorAlliances (
  LegalEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CoGuarantorId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (LegalEntityId, CoGuarantorId);

-- Transitive Edge Table: LegalEntity -> LegalEntity
CREATE TABLE CorporateControl (
  ControlledEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ControllingEntityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (ControlledEntityId, ControllingEntityId);

-- =========================================================================

  l.loanAmount,
  l.interestRate
FROM Loans l
WHERE l.loanAmount > 10000000.00;

-- ============================================================================
-- GOOGLE CLOUD SPANNER PHYSICAL RELATIONAL SCHEMA (DDL)
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Concrete Location Tables (Flattened from ex:Location)
CREATE TABLE Warehouses (
  WarehouseId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100) NOT NULL -- Enforces Warehouse cardinality restriction (1)
) PRIMARY KEY (WarehouseId);

CREATE TABLE ManufacturingPlants (
  ManufacturingPlantId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100)
) PRIMARY KEY (ManufacturingPlantId);

CREATE TABLE SupplierFacilities (
  SupplierFacilityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100)
) PRIMARY KEY (SupplierFacilityId);

-- 2. Concrete Item Tables (Flattened from ex:Item)
CREATE TABLE RawMaterials (
  RawMaterialId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  SupplierFacilityId STRING(36),
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_RawMaterial_Supplier FOREIGN KEY (SupplierFacilityId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_RawMaterial_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (RawMaterialId);

CREATE TABLE SubAssemblies (
  SubAssemblyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_SubAssembly_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (SubAssemblyId);

CREATE TABLE FinishedProducts (
  FinishedProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  ManufacturingPlantId STRING(36),
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_FinishedProduct_Plant FOREIGN KEY (ManufacturingPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_FinishedProduct_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (FinishedProductId);

-- 3. Logistics Entities
CREATE TABLE Carriers (
  CarrierId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CarrierName STRING(MAX)
) PRIMARY KEY (CarrierId);

CREATE TABLE Shipments (
  ShipmentId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ShipmentTrackingNumber STRING(MAX),
  ShipmentDate TIMESTAMP,
  CarrierId STRING(36),
  -- Polymorphic references to Locations (Origin and Destination)
  OriginWarehouseId STRING(36),
  OriginPlantId STRING(36),
  OriginSupplierId STRING(36),
  DestinationWarehouseId STRING(36),
  DestinationPlantId STRING(36),
  DestinationSupplierId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Carrier FOREIGN KEY (CarrierId) REFERENCES Carriers (CarrierId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Origin_WH FOREIGN KEY (OriginWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Origin_MP FOREIGN KEY (OriginPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Origin_SF FOREIGN KEY (OriginSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Dest_WH FOREIGN KEY (DestinationWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Dest_MP FOREIGN KEY (DestinationPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Dest_SF FOREIGN KEY (DestinationSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ShipmentId);

-- 4. Relationship / Edge Tables
-- ex:partOf (Transitive, Item -> Item)
CREATE TABLE ItemParts (
  ParentItemId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ChildItemId STRING(36) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (ParentItemId, ChildItemId);

-- ex:connectedTo (Symmetric, Location -> Location)
CREATE TABLE LocationConnections (
  SourceLocationId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  TargetLocationId STRING(36) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (SourceLocationId, TargetLocationId);


-- ============================================================================
-- SQL VIEWS FOR POLYMORPHIC GRAPH RESOLUTION
-- ============================================================================

-- Unified Location View
CREATE VIEW v_Locations SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT w.WarehouseId AS LocationId, w.LocationCode, 'Warehouse' AS LocationType FROM Warehouses w
UNION ALL
SELECT m.ManufacturingPlantId AS LocationId, m.LocationCode, 'ManufacturingPlant' AS LocationType FROM ManufacturingPlants m
UNION ALL
SELECT s.SupplierFacilityId AS LocationId, s.LocationCode, 'SupplierFacility' AS LocationType FROM SupplierFacilities s;

-- Unified Item View
CREATE VIEW v_Items SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT r.RawMaterialId AS ItemId, r.UnitCost, r.QuantityInStock, r.IsHighValue, r.WarehouseId, 'RawMaterial' AS ItemType FROM RawMaterials r
UNION ALL
SELECT s.SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, s.UnitCost, s.QuantityInStock, s.IsHighValue, s.WarehouseId, 'SubAssembly' AS ItemType FROM SubAssemblies s
UNION ALL
SELECT f.FinishedProductId AS ItemId, f.UnitCost, f.QuantityInStock, f.IsHighValue, f.WarehouseId, 'FinishedProduct' AS ItemType FROM FinishedProducts f;

-- Equivalent Class View: HighValueItem
CREATE VIEW v_HighValueItems SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT r.RawMaterialId AS ItemId, r.UnitCost, r.QuantityInStock FROM RawMaterials r WHERE r.IsHighValue = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT s.SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, s.UnitCost, s.QuantityInStock FROM SubAssemblies s WHERE s.IsHighValue = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT f.FinishedProductId AS ItemId, f.UnitCost, f.QuantityInStock FROM FinishedProducts f WHERE f.IsHighValue = TRUE;

-- Unified Shipment View resolving polymorphic Origin and Destination
CREATE VIEW v_Shipments SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT 
  s.ShipmentId,
  s.ShipmentTrackingNumber,
  s.ShipmentDate,
  s.CarrierId,
  COALESCE(s.OriginWarehouseId, s.OriginPlantId, s.OriginSupplierId) AS OriginLocationId,
  COALESCE(s.DestinationWarehouseId, s.DestinationPlantId, s.DestinationSupplierId) AS DestinationLocationId
FROM Shipments s;


-- ============================================================================
-- GOOGLE CLOUD SPANNER PROPERTY GRAPH SCHEMA
-- ============================================================================

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH SupplyChainGraph
  NODE TABLES (
    -- Concrete Locations
    Warehouses
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (WarehouseId AS LocationId, LocationCode)
      LABEL Warehouse PROPERTIES (WarehouseId, LocationCode),
    ManufacturingPlants
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (ManufacturingPlantId AS LocationId, LocationCode)
      LABEL ManufacturingPlant PROPERTIES (ManufacturingPlantId, LocationCode),
    SupplierFacilities
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (SupplierFacilityId AS LocationId, LocationCode)
      LABEL SupplierFacility PROPERTIES (SupplierFacilityId, LocationCode),
    
    -- Concrete Items
    RawMaterials
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId AS ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL RawMaterial PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue),
    SubAssemblies
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL SubAssembly PROPERTIES (SubAssemblyId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue),
    FinishedProducts
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId AS ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue)
      LABEL FinishedProduct PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue),
    
    -- Logistics Nodes
    Carriers
      LABEL Carrier PROPERTIES (CarrierId, CarrierName),
    
    -- View-Based Nodes (Polymorphic & Equivalent Classes)
    v_Locations KEY (LocationId)
      LABEL Location PROPERTIES (LocationId, LocationCode),
    v_Items KEY (ItemId)
      LABEL Item PROPERTIES (ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock, IsHighValue),
    v_HighValueItems KEY (ItemId)
      LABEL HighValueItem PROPERTIES (ItemId, UnitCost, QuantityInStock),
    v_Shipments KEY (ShipmentId)
      LABEL Shipment PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, ShipmentTrackingNumber, ShipmentDate)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    -- ex:suppliedBy (RawMaterial -> SupplierFacility)
    RawMaterials
      SOURCE KEY (RawMaterialId) REFERENCES RawMaterials (RawMaterialId)
      DESTINATION KEY (SupplierFacilityId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
      LABEL SUPPLIED_BY PROPERTIES (RawMaterialId, SupplierFacilityId),
    
    -- ex:manufacturedAt (FinishedProduct -> ManufacturingPlant)
    FinishedProducts
      SOURCE KEY (FinishedProductId) REFERENCES FinishedProducts (FinishedProductId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ManufacturingPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId)
      LABEL MANUFACTURED_AT PROPERTIES (FinishedProductId, ManufacturingPlantId),
    
    -- ex:storedIn (Item -> Warehouse)
    v_Items AS ItemStoredIn
      SOURCE KEY (ItemId) REFERENCES v_Items (ItemId)
      DESTINATION KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
      LABEL STORED_IN PROPERTIES (ItemId, WarehouseId),
    
    -- ex:shippedVia (Shipment -> Carrier)
    v_Shipments AS ShipmentShippedVia
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES v_Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (CarrierId) REFERENCES Carriers (CarrierId)
      LABEL SHIPPED_VIA PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, CarrierId),
    
    -- ex:origin (Shipment -> Location)
    v_Shipments AS ShipmentOrigin
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES v_Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (OriginLocationId) REFERENCES v_Locations (LocationId)
      LABEL ORIGIN PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, OriginLocationId),
    
    -- ex:destination (Shipment -> Location)
    v_Shipments AS ShipmentDestination
      SOURCE KEY (ShipmentId) REFERENCES v_Shipments (ShipmentId)
      DESTINATION KEY (DestinationLocationId) REFERENCES v_Locations (LocationId)
      LABEL DESTINATION PROPERTIES (ShipmentId, DestinationLocationId),
    
    -- ex:connectedTo (Symmetric: Location -> Location)
    LocationConnections
      SOURCE KEY (SourceLocationId) REFERENCES v_Locations (LocationId)
      DESTINATION KEY (TargetLocationId) REFERENCES v_Locations (LocationId)
      LABEL CONNECTED_TO PROPERTIES (SourceLocationId, TargetLocationId),
    
    -- ex:partOf (Transitive: Item -> Item)
    ItemParts
      SOURCE KEY (ChildItemId) REFERENCES v_Items (ItemId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ParentItemId) REFERENCES v_Items (ItemId)
      LABEL PART_OF PROPERTIES (ChildItemId, ParentItemId),
    
    -- ex:hasPart (Inverse of partOf: Item -> Item)

      SOURCE KEY (ParentItemId) REFERENCES v_Items (ItemId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ChildItemId) REFERENCES v_Items (ItemId)
      LABEL HAS_PART PROPERTIES (ParentItemId, ChildItemId)

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. PHYSICAL RELATIONAL SCHEMA (DDL)
-- ============================================================================

-- Concrete Location Tables (Flattened from ex:Location)
CREATE TABLE Warehouses (
  WarehouseId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (WarehouseId);

CREATE TABLE ManufacturingPlants (
  ManufacturingPlantId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100)
) PRIMARY KEY (ManufacturingPlantId);

CREATE TABLE SupplierFacilities (
  SupplierFacilityId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  LocationCode STRING(100)
) PRIMARY KEY (SupplierFacilityId);

-- Concrete Item Tables (Flattened from ex:Item)
CREATE TABLE RawMaterials (
  RawMaterialId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  SupplierFacilityId STRING(36),
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_RawMaterial_Supplier FOREIGN KEY (SupplierFacilityId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_RawMaterial_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (RawMaterialId);

CREATE TABLE SubAssemblies (
  SubAssemblyId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_SubAssembly_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (SubAssemblyId);

CREATE TABLE FinishedProducts (
  FinishedProductId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  UnitCost NUMERIC,
  QuantityInStock INT64,
  -- Equivalent Class Rule: HighValueItem (unitCost > 5000.00)
  IsHighValue BOOL AS (UnitCost > 5000.00) STORED,
  ManufacturingPlantId STRING(36),
  WarehouseId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_FinishedProduct_Plant FOREIGN KEY (ManufacturingPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_FinishedProduct_Warehouse FOREIGN KEY (WarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId)
) PRIMARY KEY (FinishedProductId);

-- Logistics Entities
CREATE TABLE Carriers (
  CarrierId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  CarrierName STRING(MAX)
) PRIMARY KEY (CarrierId);

CREATE TABLE Shipments (
  ShipmentId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ShipmentTrackingNumber STRING(MAX),
  ShipmentDate TIMESTAMP,
  CarrierId STRING(36),
  -- Polymorphic references to Locations (Origin and Destination)
  OriginWarehouseId STRING(36),
  OriginPlantId STRING(36),
  OriginSupplierId STRING(36),
  DestinationWarehouseId STRING(36),
  DestinationPlantId STRING(36),
  DestinationSupplierId STRING(36),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Carrier FOREIGN KEY (CarrierId) REFERENCES Carriers (CarrierId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Origin_WH FOREIGN KEY (OriginWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Origin_MP FOREIGN KEY (OriginPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Origin_SF FOREIGN KEY (OriginSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Dest_WH FOREIGN KEY (DestinationWarehouseId) REFERENCES Warehouses (WarehouseId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Dest_MP FOREIGN KEY (DestinationPlantId) REFERENCES ManufacturingPlants (ManufacturingPlantId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Shipment_Dest_SF FOREIGN KEY (DestinationSupplierId) REFERENCES SupplierFacilities (SupplierFacilityId)
) PRIMARY KEY (ShipmentId);

-- Relationship / Edge Tables
-- ex:partOf (Transitive, Item -> Item)
CREATE TABLE ItemParts (
  ParentItemId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  ChildItemId STRING(36) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (ParentItemId, ChildItemId);

-- ex:connectedTo (Symmetric, Location -> Location)
CREATE TABLE LocationConnections (
  SourceLocationId STRING(36) NOT NULL,
  TargetLocationId STRING(36) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (SourceLocationId, TargetLocationId);


-- ============================================================================
-- 2. SQL VIEWS (FOR QUERY CONVENIENCE & VERIFIABLE GRAPH NODES)
-- ============================================================================

-- Verifiable Single-Table Views for Equivalent Class: HighValueItem
CREATE VIEW v_HighValueRawMaterials SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT r.RawMaterialId AS ItemId, r.UnitCost, r.QuantityInStock 
FROM RawMaterials r 
WHERE r.IsHighValue = TRUE;

CREATE VIEW v_HighValueSubAssemblies SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT s.SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, s.UnitCost, s.QuantityInStock 
FROM SubAssemblies s 
WHERE s.IsHighValue = TRUE;

CREATE VIEW v_HighValueFinishedProducts SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT f.FinishedProductId AS ItemId, f.UnitCost, f.QuantityInStock 
FROM FinishedProducts f 
WHERE f.IsHighValue = TRUE;

-- General Polymorphic Views (Maintained for standard SQL querying convenience)
CREATE VIEW v_Locations SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT w.WarehouseId AS LocationId, w.LocationCode, 'Warehouse' AS LocationType FROM Warehouses w
UNION ALL
SELECT m.ManufacturingPlantId AS LocationId, m.LocationCode, 'ManufacturingPlant' AS LocationType FROM ManufacturingPlants m
UNION ALL
SELECT s.SupplierFacilityId AS LocationId, s.LocationCode, 'SupplierFacility' AS LocationType FROM SupplierFacilities s;

CREATE VIEW v_Items SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS
SELECT r.RawMaterialId AS ItemId, r.UnitCost, r.QuantityInStock, r.IsHighValue, r.WarehouseId, 'RawMaterial' AS ItemType FROM RawMaterials r
UNION ALL
SELECT s.SubAssemblyId AS ItemId, s.UnitCost, s.QuantityInStock, s.IsHighValue, s.WarehouseId, 'SubAssembly' AS ItemType FROM SubAssemblies s
UNION ALL
SELECT f.FinishedProductId AS ItemId, f.UnitCost, f.QuantityInStock, f.IsHighValue, f.WarehouseId, 'FinishedProduct' AS ItemType FROM FinishedProducts f;

-- =============================================================================
-- Relational Schema (Table-Per-Concrete-Class Pattern)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE Buildings (
  BuildingId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  BuildingName STRING(MAX) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (BuildingId);

CREATE TABLE Apartments (
  ApartmentId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  ApartmentNumber STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  LocatedOnFloor INT64 NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (ApartmentId);

CREATE TABLE States (
  StateId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  StateName STRING(MAX) NOT NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (StateId);

CREATE TABLE Cities (
  CityId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  CityName STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  EstablishedDate DATE
) PRIMARY KEY (CityId);

CREATE TABLE BuildingApartments (
  BuildingId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  ApartmentId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_BA_Building FOREIGN KEY (BuildingId) REFERENCES Buildings (BuildingId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_BA_Apartment FOREIGN KEY (ApartmentId) REFERENCES Apartments (ApartmentId)
) PRIMARY KEY (BuildingId, ApartmentId);

CREATE TABLE StateCities (
  StateId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  CityId STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT FK_SC_State FOREIGN KEY (StateId) REFERENCES States (StateId),
  CONSTRAINT FK_SC_City FOREIGN KEY (CityId) REFERENCES Cities (CityId)
) PRIMARY KEY (StateId, CityId);

-- =============================================================================
-- Property Graph Schema
-- =============================================================================

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH ContainmentGraph
  NODE TABLES (
    Buildings
      LABEL Building PROPERTIES (BuildingId, BuildingName)
      LABEL SpatialEntity PROPERTIES (BuildingId AS SpatialEntityId),
    Apartments
      LABEL Apartment PROPERTIES (ApartmentId, ApartmentNumber, LocatedOnFloor)
      LABEL SpatialEntity PROPERTIES (ApartmentId AS SpatialEntityId),
    States
      LABEL State PROPERTIES (StateId, StateName)
      LABEL SpatialEntity PROPERTIES (StateId AS SpatialEntityId),
    Cities
      LABEL City PROPERTIES (CityId, CityName, EstablishedDate)
      LABEL SpatialEntity PROPERTIES (CityId AS SpatialEntityId)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    BuildingApartments
      SOURCE KEY (BuildingId) REFERENCES Buildings (BuildingId)
      DESTINATION KEY (ApartmentId) REFERENCES Apartments (ApartmentId)
      LABEL BUILDING_CONTAINS_APARTMENT PROPERTIES (BuildingId, ApartmentId)
      LABEL CONTAINS PROPERTIES (BuildingId AS SourceEntityId, ApartmentId AS TargetEntityId),
    StateCities
      SOURCE KEY (StateId) REFERENCES States (StateId)
      DESTINATION KEY (CityId) REFERENCES Cities (CityId)
      LABEL STATE_CONTAINS_CITY PROPERTIES (StateId, CityId)
      LABEL CONTAINS PROPERTIES (StateId AS SourceEntityId, CityId AS TargetEntityId)
  );
